# 6️⃣使用 with：线程池的“自动回收”写法，离开 with 代码块时自动执行 shutdown(wait=True)
def work(n, lock):
    with lock:
        print(f'work正在执行任务{n}.........{get_native_id()}')
    if n == 1:
        time.sleep(15)
    elif n == 2:
        time.sleep(10)
    else:
        time.sleep(1)
    return f'任务{n}的结果'

if __name__ == '__main__':
    print('---------start-------------')
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(3) as executor:
        # 创建线程锁
        lock = RLock()
        # 使用map方法批量提交任务
        result = executor.map(work, [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7], [lock]*7)
        # 打印最终的结果
        print(list(result))
    print('---------end-------------')
